definitions.gloss: to encourage; to hearten; to inspire courage in
definitions.explanation: To give someone courage or confidence, helping them feel braver or more motivated. A compound verb from 勇気 (courage) + づける (to give, to imbue with).

examples.japanese: ⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{勇気|ゆうき}づけた。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{言葉|ことば}→言葉：02880_kotoba⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{勇気|ゆうき}づけられた。
examples.english: I was encouraged by his words.

examples.japanese: ⟦{落|お}ち{込|こ}んでいる→落ち込む：05750_ochikomu⟧⟦{後輩|こうはい}→後輩：02501_kouhai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{勇気|ゆうき}づける⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かけた→かける：00854_kakeru⟧。
examples.english: I spoke to my junior to encourage them when they were feeling down.

notes:
USAGE:
{勇気|ゆうき}づける is an ichidan (ru-verb) that means to give someone courage. The passive form {勇気|ゆうき}づけられる (to be encouraged) is very common.

SIMILAR WORDS:
⟦{励|はげ}ます→励ます：05304_hagemasu⟧ also means to encourage, but has a broader scope and is more commonly used in everyday speech. {勇気|ゆうき}づける specifically emphasizes giving someone courage or bravery.
